craft_notes: Sthāyin: the two gates (ear + lower: sound-seal then root-seal — the method's geometry). Sanskrit: karṇabandhaḥ...adhogatāv api...tāmrādibhiḥ samprokṣitāṃ kṣīṇaśoṇitāṃ dhyātvā...nityaṃ brahmādhigacchati → L4 keeps contraction-lower-gate line 1, unpolluted-entry line 2. Rows: row 3 (meditating→entered). Close: entered (adhigacchati — brahman ENTERED, not seen: the entry-verb refrain with v85). Rejected: 'sacred sites' for tāmrādibhiḥ class-word — killed: unsmeared-ploughed kept (what soil DOESN'T receive: images kept soil-like); 'Khecarī mudrā' tech-label — killed: gates kept (bandha as closure, plain).

lines: unsmeared, unploughed, meditating — eternal brahman entered.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃkocaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛtvā hy adhodvāre tathaiva ca | anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam

reads_against.argmap: How does one enter brahma? → Ear-contraction plus the lower gate, meditating unsmeared, enters eternal brahman.
c1_essence: Ear-contraction, lower gate: meditating enters eternal brahman.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
